master.definition_en: Primary congenital glaucoma (PCG) is characterized by elevated intraocular pressure (IOP), enlargement of the globe (buphthalmos), edema, and opacification of the cornea with rupture of Descemet's membrane (Haab's striae), thinning of the anterior sclera and iris atrophy, anomalously deep anterior chamber, and structurally normal posterior segment except for progressive glaucomatous optic atrophy. Symptoms include photophobia, blepharospasm, and excessive tearing. Typically, the diagnosis is made in the first year of life. Depending on when treatment is instituted, visual acuity may be reduced and/or visual fields may be restricted. In untreated individuals, blindness invariably occurs.

curated.category: 妇科慢性炎症与激素依赖性疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 活性子宫内膜组织种植于卵巢、盆腔腹膜或肠壁/膀胱，随月经周期反复出血粘连（绝不直接致命），但可引发进行性痛经、慢性盆腔痛、性交痛及30%–50%的不孕；极少数卵巢巧克力囊肿突发破裂可致急性剧烈腹痛与化学性腹膜炎，长期内异症略微增加卵巢透明细胞癌风险。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 被视为需要“全生命周期慢性病管理”的疾病（单纯手术切除易复发且伤及卵巢储备）；通过口服高效孕激素地诺孕素（Dienogest，已纳入国家常规药品目录）、左炔诺孕酮宫内缓释系统（曼月乐）或GnRH-a/口服GnRH拮抗剂长期抑制病灶，可有效止痛并显著降低复发率。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD 2021未将其列为直接死因，主要负担为疼痛致残与生育力受损
annual_deaths_global.source: WHO Endometriosis Fact Sheet / IHME GBD 2021

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球约10%（约1.9亿例）育龄期女性受累（WHO），GBD 2021估算活跃点患病病例超2,200万例

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 卵巢囊肿破裂急腹症处置：1) 若在经期前后突发剧烈下腹撕裂样疼痛伴肛门坠胀、恶心冷汗或发热，高度怀疑卵巢巧克力囊肿破裂或蒂扭转，立即急诊妇科行超声检查并评估抗炎/腹腔镜手术探查。

standard_drugs.drug_class: 促性腺激素释放激素激动剂（长效闭经针）

non_drug_therapies_zh: 科学手术观念：切忌“动辄反复开刀剥除卵巢囊肿”导致卵巢功能早衰，有生育需求者应先评估AMH卵巢储备并与生殖科联合制定方案

research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 患者从首发痛经到确诊平均延误长达7–10年，缺乏高敏感度无创血液/影像早筛手段；2) 停用激素抑制药后病灶极易复发，且现有内分泌药物治疗期间均抑制排卵无法同时备孕；3) 口服GnRH拮抗剂及非激素靶向止痛药在中国内地仍需加速可及。

master.definition_en: An anxiety disorder precipitated by an experience of intense fear or horror while exposed to a traumatic (especially life-threatening) event. The disorder is characterized by intrusive recurring thoughts or images of the traumatic event; avoidance of anything associated with the event; a state of hyperarousal and diminished emotional responsiveness. These symptoms are present for at least one month and the disorder is usually long-term.

mechanisms: Sodium channel protein type IV alpha subunit blocker

curated.category: 精神与创伤应激相关障碍
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 经历或目睹威胁生命的重大创伤事件（灾难、事故、暴力、虐待）后持续出现的创伤闪回、噩梦、极度警觉与情感麻木；疾病本身不直接破坏器官，但显著升高重度抑郁、酒精药物滥用及自杀风险（自杀风险较常人高2–5倍）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 属于可高度康复的创伤后障碍！WHO与全球指南一致将**创伤聚焦认知行为疗法（TF-CBT）**与**眼动脱敏与再加工疗法（EMDR）**列为首选一线治疗，配合舍曲林、帕罗西汀等SSRI药物，多数患者可成功脱敏并重新回归安全生活。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO未将PTSD单列为直接死因，主要死亡风险来源于共病抑郁与自杀
annual_deaths_global.source: WHO Post-traumatic stress disorder Fact Sheet

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球一般人群终生患病率约3.9%（WHO世界心理健康调查），创伤暴露人群及战乱灾区高达15%–30%以上
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国普通人群终身患病率约0.3%–1.5%（因文化含蓄可能存在低报），重大自然灾害/突发事件幸存者中患病率可达10%–25%

standard_drugs.drug_class: α1肾上腺素能受体拮抗剂

non_drug_therapies_zh: 眼动脱敏与再加工疗法（EMDR）及创伤聚焦认知行为疗法（TF-CBT / 延长暴露疗法）：WHO强烈推荐的一线核心治本心理疗法，帮助大脑将“停留在当下的恐惧记忆”重新编码归档为过去记忆
避坑提示：切忌依靠酒精、镇静安眠药（苯二氮卓类长期使用反而妨碍恐惧消退且极易成瘾）来麻痹逃避创伤记忆
建立安全支持网络，避免创伤后反复强迫患者向无关人员复述细节造成二次创伤
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 常规SSRI药物及门诊随访年费约1,000–2,500元；系统EMDR/TF-CBT心理治疗（通常12–20次）总费用约6,000–20,000元人民币

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 心理治疗辅助神经调控新药（如MDMA辅助心理治疗虽在2024年因试验设计争议未获FDA首次批准，但仍在优化3期方案；鼻喷艾司氯胺酮及神经可塑性调节剂正探索快速阻断创伤记忆巩固）；2) 数字化VR虚拟现实暴露疗法与AI语音心理筛查正在扩大创伤后早期干预覆盖面。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 现有SSRI药物总体缓解率仅约40%–50%，对情感麻木与复杂性PTSD（CPTSD）疗效有限；2) 具备正规EMDR/TF-CBT资质的创伤心理治疗师在三四线城市与灾后一线严重匮乏；3) 长期慢性家庭暴力或童年创伤所致CPTSD识别率极低。

master.definition_en: Ocular cicatricial pemphigoid (OCP) is a form of mucous membrane pemphigoid (a group of rare, chronic autoimmune disorders) that affects the eyes. In the early stages, people with OCPgenerally experience chronic or relapsing conjunctivitis that is often characterized by tearing, irritation, burning, and/or mucus drainage. If left untreated, OCP can progress to severe conjunctiva scarring and vision loss. Involvement of other mucosal sites and the skin may also occur in OCP. The exact underlying cause is currently unknown. The treatment of OCP aims to slow disease progression and prevent complications. This usually involves long-term use of medications called immunomodulators which help regulate or normalize the immune system.

master.definition_en: Pelvic dysplasia-arthrogryposis of lower limbs syndrome is a rare, genetic, dysostosis syndrome characterized by intrauterine growth restriction, short stature (with short lower segment), lower limb joint contractures and muscular hypotrophy, narrow, small pelvis, lumbar hyperlordosis with scoliosis, and foot deformity (short, overlapping toes). master.definition_en: Congenital smooth muscle hamartoma (CSMH) is a rare cutaneous hamartomatous lesion most often located on the lumbosacral area or proximal limbs (but rarely on atypical areas such as scalp, eyelid or foot) and characterized by a disorganized proliferation of smooth muscle fibers of arrector pili presenting usually as a localized skin-colored or hyperpigmented plaque (up to 10 cm in diameter) with prominent vellus hairs (most common classic form) or less commonly by multiple skin-colored papules that can coalesce to form irregularly shaped plaques. With time, hyperpigmentation and vellus hairs usually diminish and neither malignant transformation nor associated systemic involvement has been reported.

master.definition_en: A rare genetic leukodystrophy characterized by infantile onset of stagnation and regression of motor and language development resulting in complete lack of communication and purposeful movement. Further neurological manifestations include truncal hypotonia, appendicular spasticity, dystonia, optic disc pallor, peripheral neuropathy, and neurogenic bladder. Patients also present multiple contractures, late-onset relative macrocephaly, short stature, and facial dysmorphism (including coarse facial features, sloping forehead, thick eyebrows, low-set ears, prominent nose, flat philtrum, and prominent lower lip). Brain imaging at advanced stages shows diffuse abnormal white matter signal and severe atrophy. Sural nerve biopsy reveals decreased myelination.
